name: goal-evolver-every-10
script: n=$(find ~/.ion/agent/goal-runs -name 'iterations.jsonl' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); stamp=~/.ion/agent/.evolver-last-count; prev=$(cat "$stamp" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo $n > "$stamp"; [ $((n - prev)) -ge 10 ] && echo "new_goals=$((n - prev))"
prompt_template:
{output}

10+ new goals accumulated. Run goal_evolver_run_once on ~/.ion/agent/goal-runs/ (dry_run=false) and submit Issues.
